pages.text: “A soft orchid fragrance drifts in the air, serene and noble.”$(br2)Blue Orchid Tea is a delicate and mysterious beverage made from dried orchid petals. The tea is clear with a faint floral scent. Drinking it grants travelers increased Luck, enhancing their chances of finding valuable resources and rewards during their journeys.

$(br2)$(br)Brewing Blue Orchid Tea is simple—$(br)blend dried orchid petals with sugar to create this aromatic drink.$(br)It is best consumed before venturing into unknown territories, bringing a touch of fortune to the traveler’s journey.

Upon drinking Blue Orchid Tea, travelers will receive a Luck effect, increasing their chances of obtaining extra rewards when gathering, fighting, or exploring.$(br)This elegant and mysterious tea is perfect for those seeking good fortune.$(br)If JEI is installed, press R while hovering over the icon to view the recipe.
